pageProps.content: ## Review I visited this place after traveling on the `Haeundae Beach Train`. It wasn't a place I visited with high expectations, but the view was much better than I thought. At the entrance, there was a decoration showing the cafe's identity. Compared to the atmosphere at the entrance, the interior felt surprisingly clean and modern. Seeing a note that they serve it with an egg yolk, I ordered `ssanghwa-tang` (traditional herbal tea) and an `iced americano` without hesitation. The `ssanghwa-tang` was on the sweeter side and was packed with nuts. Personally, I thought it could have been a bit less sweet. On the contrary, the coffee suited my taste better as it was savory with low acidity. I spent a relaxing time sitting in a spot perfect for spacing out while looking at the sea. ## Pictures
